title: Existence and stability of solutions of the Dirichlet problem for the $p$-Poisson equation in metric measure spaces
summary: We study the Dirichlet problem for the $p$-Poisson equation in the metric measure space setting equipped with a doubling measure and supporting a $(p,p)$-Poincaré inequality. We prove the existence of the solutions by using a variational approach. We prove the stability and uniqueness of the solutions, when the space is also geodesic.
